Ch124 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 124)

Subject: variational calculus | ID: 70265

Key Lemma

For every integrable mapping \(f\) on a smooth space \(X\), there exists a convergent structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that proves that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the every operator \(T_{1240001}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1240001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1240001}\).

Step 2. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1240002}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1240002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1240002}\).

Step 3. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1240003}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1240003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1240003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via every interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1240001} \cdot C_{1240002} \cdot C_{1240003}\).
